'''Fegorosk IV''' was a terrestrial celestial body<ref name="Journal9" /> located in the [[Fegorosk system/Legends|Fegorosk system]], a part of the [[Obtrexta sector/Legends|Obtrexta sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[New Territories/Legends|New Territories]] portion of<ref name="TEA Fegorosk" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{JournalCite|9|Death-Hunter}} is set during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], which corresponds to some time between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> a dank, smoky club on Fegorosk IV at which the [[swuvehorn]]<ref name="Journal9" /> [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument<ref name="GamemasterToolkit">''[[Gamemaster Toolkit: Live-Action Adventures]]''</ref> was played was among the locales recreated in [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] form at the [[Arcade Omicron]], a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on<ref name="Journal9" /> the Obtrexta [[Sector/Legends|sector]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bescane/Legends|Bescane]].<ref name="Journal9" />

==Behind the scenes==
Fegorosk IV was introduced in "[[Death-Hunter]]," a [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure written by [[Tony Russo]], illustrated by [[Doug Shuler]], and published for use with [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' in the [[February]] [[1996]] [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 9|ninth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' magazine. In the adventure, the celestial body is depicted in holographic form.<ref name="Journal9" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Fegorosk [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Fegorosk IV, in grid square K-4.<ref name="TEA Fegorosk" />
